{"findings": [{"rule_id": "LAW-CA-BPC-16600", "document": "California Business and Professions Code", "type": "statutory_risk", "evidence": [65], "explanation": "Clause 65 bars the Receiving Party, for 24 months after termination, from engaging in or assisting any business that competes with the Disclosing Party. The governing law is blank in the NDA, so this is a risk to confirm, not a confirmed violation."}]}

{"findings": [{"document": "Engineering Data Handling Policy", "quote": "The time allowed to the other side for returning or destroying our materials must be at least 10 days, so that the recipient can find and process all of it.", "type": "violation", "evidence": [86], "explanation": "Clause 86 requires the Recipient to return all materials and copies immediately.
